title: Broca's Brain
subtitle: Reflections on the Romance of Science

first_sentence.value: IT WAS A MUSEUM, in a way like any other, this Musee de l'Homme, Museum of Man, situated on a pleasant eminence with, from the restaurant plaza in back, a splendid view of the Eiffel Tower.
